sermon.title: The Peace of God Surpasses All Understanding 11/17/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God’s promise of success includes peace that surpasses understanding. Jesus promised trouble but peace in Him. Job, Daniel’s friends, Joseph, David and the priest who hid Joash had that peace. Much harm is self-inflicted, but in Christ we are more than conquerors.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He says David was a divorced man whose wife left him; kept as spoken. Statistics are kept as spoken and were not checked.
